steps.title: After red Hot appears
steps.rule: Go to 8m west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 8m east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 8m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 8m east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 8m east of the centre.

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Fire).

PhysRangedDps.rule: If you are in Fire: Go to the south wall; otherwise: Go to the north wall.

CasterDps.rule: If you are in Fire: Go to the south wall; otherwise: Go to the north wall.

steps.title: After sprint on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Fire).

RegenHealer.rule: If you are in Fire: Go to the north-east wall; otherwise: Go to the south-west wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: If you are in Fire: Go to the north-east wall; otherwise: Go to the south-west wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: If you are in Fire: Go to the south-west wall; otherwise: Go to the north-east wall.

CasterDps.rule: If you are in Fire: Go to the south-west wall; otherwise: Go to the north-east wall.
